latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — generate short AI videos from text prompts, free and cloud-powered.

- Create and manage video generation sessions via secure backend API.
- Convert user text prompts into 1080p MP4 video clips in 1–2 minutes.
- Upload and process MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF files (up to 500MB).
- View balances, track status, and export completed videos securely.
- Supports additional formats: MOV, AVI, JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC.
- Handles authentication, error cases, and streamlines video generation workflows for creators.
